name: EarthSpatialBench
description: EarthSpatialBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models on Earth imagery. It includes over 325K question-answer pairs covering qualitative and quantitative reasoning about spatial distance, direction, topological relations, and complex object geometries using textual, visual, and geometric references.
reputation: A very large and recent multimodal spatial-reasoning benchmark that is likely to see increasing use, but it is not yet widely established as a community standard.
notes: Focuses on spatial reasoning in Earth imagery including quantitative direction, distance, topological relations, and complex geometries beyond bounding boxes.
